title: Troubling Taxonomies in GenAI Evaluation
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper is a conceptual critique of evaluation taxonomies and does not propose or use a benchmark to measure anything specific, including aspects of faith or religion.
findings: This paper does not analyze or discuss any aspects of religion or faith. Its focus is on the limitations of current taxonomies for evaluating the societal impacts of GenAI and argues for a governance-first approach.
